description: This PHP source file defines the class 'FormatWithCountryCode', which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It is responsible for formatting country codes into country names by retrieving the country entity via a service container.

classes.name: FormatWithCountryCode
classes.description: A class that formats country codes into country names using a service container to retrieve country entities.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the country name corresponding to a given country code, or null if not found.
